stand_off_px.note: pivot to the prop's near face; tolerance +-2 px (her contact pixels are only 1-2 px deep)

contact_boxes_px.note: Art contact in sprite pixels relative to the pivot, facing right: x forward, y up from the floor, inclusive; measured from the keys by tests/test_art_interact01.py. A guide for gameplay data, not authoritative collision.

interact_paw.role: low switch or small item on a step, one front paw; a cat never grips or pulls

interact_nudge.role: small item or floor plate, muzzle and forehead
